scope: 13-table teaching extract; 12 core model tables; not a whole-estate model

AssetCode: Human-readable asset code, distinct from its numeric key.
AssetType: Equipment category used for maintenance grouping.
InstallDate: Calendar date the fictional equipment entered service.
Criticality: Demo operational criticality band; not a clinical classification.
CustomerKey: Stable customer identifier; orphan 999 is deliberately seeded.
Segment: Demo customer segmentation label requiring SME approval elsewhere.
Country: Country name; raw extracts include deliberate code and case variants.
DateKey: Calendar date encoded YYYYMMDD; invalid raw dates are quarantined.
Date: ISO calendar date corresponding to DateKey.
Day: Day number within the calendar month.
Week: Source week number; week convention requires SME confirmation before reuse.
FiscalYear: Source year label; demo maps it to Year, not a confirmed customer fiscal calendar.
IsMonthEnd: 1 on the final calendar day of a month, otherwise 0.
DefectTypeKey: Defect classification key; missing values map to unknown member -1.
ProcessType: Manufacturing process performed on the line.
CapacityPerHour: Nominal demo line output capacity per hour; not measured throughput.
PlantCode: Site code, normalized by trimming and uppercasing.
PlantManager: Explicit fictional role placeholder, not a real person's identity.
ProductName: Fictional product display name, normalized by trimming.
Category: Product category, normalized to title case.
UnitPrice: Demo sales price per unit; currency context requires SME confirmation.
StandardCost: Demo standard cost per unit, not an actual cost ledger.
StartTime: Source local shift start time; timezone not supplied.
EndTime: Source local shift end time; may cross midnight.
IsNightShift: 1 for the demo night shift, otherwise 0.
AnomalyEventID: Unique identifier of a seeded illustration, not an actual alert.
EventTimestamp: Source illustration date; no actual timestamp precision is claimed.
MetricName: Metric named by the seeded anomaly illustration.
CurrentValue: Illustrative observed metric value; units depend on MetricName.
ThresholdValue: Illustrative metric threshold, not a production rule.
Severity: Source severity label normalized to title case.
BusinessImpact: Synthetic narrative hypothesis, not verified causation.
RecommendedAction: Illustrative investigation suggestion, not permission to execute.
NotificationRecipient: Non-routable example.invalid address; never send a notification.
NotificationChannel: Illustrative notification channel; no integration is configured.
ShippedUnits: Units shipped; zero for deliberately open orders.
LateShipmentFlag: Source-supplied late flag; not recomputed from seeded shipping dates.
Revenue: Synthetic source order revenue, retained even on seeded open orders.
RequiredShipDate: Requested shipping date; raw ISO and day-first formats coexist.
ActualShipDate: Actual shipping date; blank means an open demo order.
DowntimeMinutes: Recorded minutes of downtime at the row's fact grain; do not sum across facts blindly.
RootCause: Source maintenance cause label; blank maps to Unknown, not inferred causation.
MaintenanceCost: Synthetic cost of a maintenance event.
PreventiveFlag: Preventive maintenance indicator; explicit raw true and false variants are normalized.
ProductionRunID: Unique production run identifier after removal of exact duplicate extracts.
PlannedUnits: Planned good units for a production run.
ActualUnits: Good units produced; scrap is separate in the demo KPI definition.
ScrapUnits: Scrapped units; negative raw quantities are quarantined.
ReworkUnits: Units requiring rework; no extra yield calculation is assumed.
CycleTimeSeconds: Source run cycle time in seconds; aggregation semantics require an SME.
OperatorTeam: Fictional operator team normalized to Team-A, Team-B or Team-C.
BatchID: Source batch label shared across events; not a unique join key.
InspectedUnits: Units inspected at this inspection's grain.
DefectCount: Demo defective-unit count; values exceeding inspected units are quarantined by design.

entities.grain: one row per illustrative anomaly; bronze only, excluded from core reporting

quality_rules.exact_duplicates: retain one identical business row; reject conflicting keys

sme_questions: Is ActualUnits good output, and is scrap divided by good plus scrap the approved definition?
Can one inspected unit have multiple defects? The demo rejects DefectCount > InspectedUnits by design, not as a universal rule.
Which timezone, week convention, calendar and fiscal year apply?
Should source revenue on unshipped demo orders count as recognized revenue?
What do LateShipmentFlag and unknown dimension members mean in the approved business process?
